content.user_title: Create Claude Code Skills With Clear Structure
content.value_statement: Building a Claude Code skill can be confusing when structure, metadata, and supporting files are unclear. This guide shows the required SKILL.md layout, common directory patterns, and naming practices.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md file and YAML metadata fields.
Shows basic and expanded directory layouts for Claude Code Skills.
Describes progressive disclosure with reference files, examples, templates, and scripts.
Lists personal and project skill storage paths for Claude Code.
Provides naming examples and names to avoid for skill authors.
Links key guidance to Claude documentation for further review.
limitations: Does not create or install a skill automatically.
Does not validate current Claude Code documentation after publication.
Uses general examples that may need adaptation for specific workflows.
Source guidance includes Chinese and English text.

use_cases.title: Build a First Skill
use_cases.description: Use the guide to draft a minimal SKILL.md with required metadata and clear instructions.

use_cases.title: Organize Team Skills
use_cases.description: Plan project skill folders and shared references before adding them to a repository.

use_cases.title: Document Skill Standards
use_cases.description: Create internal guidance for names, structure, supporting files, and progressive disclosure.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Minimal Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner author creating a first Claude Code skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a minimal Claude Code skill for [task]. Include the name, description, instructions, and example sections.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Supporting Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Author expanding beyond a single SKILL.md file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan supporting files for a Claude Code skill about [workflow]. Identify references, examples, scripts, and templates.

prompt_templates.title: Review Skill Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Maintainer checking an existing skill before publication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Claude Code skill structure. Check metadata, directory layout, naming, and progressive disclosure.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Skill Collection
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced team organizing many related skills.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a repository layout for multiple Claude Code skills across [domains]. Recommend folder names and shared documentation.

output_examples.input: Create a Claude Code skill for reviewing pull requests.
output_examples.output: A concise skill plan with metadata guidance, instruction sections, examples, and optional supporting references.

output_examples.input: Review our planned skill directory for spreadsheet analysis.
output: Suggests reference and examples files for advanced details.
Flags unclear names and deep nesting risks.

output_examples.input: Organize four project skills for an engineering repository.
output_examples.output: A project-level folder plan with separate skill directories and clear names for each workflow.

best_practices: Keep the main SKILL.md concise and move detailed guidance into support files.
Use specific action names that describe the workflow the skill supports.
Separate personal skill examples from project skill examples when documenting setup.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague skill names such as Helper, Utils, or Tools.
Do not bury important instructions in deeply nested reference files.
Do not treat example setup commands as automatic installation steps.

faq.question: Does this skill install Claude Code skills?
faq.answer: No. It explains how to structure and document skills, but installation remains a user action.

faq.question: Can I use this guidance with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It is useful for understanding Claude Code skill structure while planning compatible marketplace content for Codex users.

faq.question: Does the skill require network access?
faq.answer: No. It includes documentation links, but it does not perform network requests.

faq.question: What files does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes SKILL.md, optional references, examples, scripts, templates, and project skill folders.

faq.question: Is the source content multilingual?
faq.answer: Yes. The source guidance includes Chinese prose with English examples and file names.

faq.question: Can it validate a finished skill?
faq.answer: It can guide a manual review, but it does not run schema validation or security scanning.
